cards.title: Twice the maze
cards.text: Every cell is now 2x2, dead ends are short, and brown blocks can be broken. Plus your fixes.
cards.why: Your notes from the fixes deck and the start of the stage 4 deck. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.7.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

parts.title: Maze 2x
parts.text: Corridors and walls twice as big; you're the same size. Same number of squares, so a run covers more ground.

parts.title: Short dead ends
parts.text: A dead end is at most 2 squares deep now; longer branches join back into the maze. No round rooms.

parts.title: Breakable blocks
parts.text: Brown blocks: arms off corridor walls (some reach across), crates you go round, and barriers between corridors. Shots chip them, dashes hit hard, brutes grind through.

parts.title: Dash and spawn
parts.text: Dash 9 cells (was 6). A spawn is thrown softly and rolls about 4 cells.

parts.title: Dart
parts.text: Sees you from 11 cells (was 16) and charges faster, for a shorter way.

parts.title: Camps go home
parts.text: Leave a camp's room for 3 seconds and it goes back, heals and rests.

parts.title: Level-up cards
parts.text: The first level-up offers new modules. After that any card can be a new module, more often every 3rd level. Bands say what kind: New module, Upgrade, You.

parts.title: Build: drag
parts.text: Drag a module onto another cast to move it. No buttons.
